Careers at JaiDeeClear — Sales Executive (Bangkok / Phuket)
JaiDeeClear is hiring a bilingual Sales Executive in Bangkok or Phuket. Base salary plus uncapped commission at a premium window film company.

JaiDeeClear installs premium window film for villas, condos, offices, and yachts across Thailand. We are growing fast and are hiring a bilingual Sales Executive based in Bangkok or Phuket to drive new business.

What you'll do:

  • Sales outreach to property developers and commercial clients
  • Chase and qualify inbound leads from Meta ads
  • Send quotes, follow up, and close deals
  • Book on-site measurements for the install team
  • Keep your pipeline clean in the CRM (light admin)

You're a fit if you have:

  • 1-3 years in sales, telesales, or B2B outreach
  • Fluent Thai and English, spoken and written
  • Self-driven and target-oriented
  • Based in Bangkok or Phuket

What we offer: competitive base salary plus uncapped commission, a fast-growing company, and clear room to grow.
